name: Mohammed Hadi Al-Rasheed Company
summary: Mohammed Hadi Al-Rasheed Company produces silica sand for various industrial applications in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It operates through two segments: The Mining Sector and The Military Maintenance Sector. The company offers granites and marble stone; aggregates; and asphalt products, as well as gravel and blocks. It also provides military, general maintenance, and contracting services. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
